tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Fresh new production-quality transparent RGBA illustration: exactly FOUR full-body poses in a strict 2 by 2 row-major grid of the exact Tree Kangaroo adopted in image1. Image1 is identity/style/proportion reference only, not an edit target. Highest native resolution available. Preserve precisely its head-to-torso ratio, torso length/thickness, face, eye format, palette, warm brown line character, gentle clean watercolor paper texture, distinctive markings, horns/ears/bill/tail and original limb count. Generous transparent margins around each complete subject. No text, labels, border, grid lines, floor, shadows, background, props, clothing, effects, sparkles or extra animals. Keep the lightly anthropomorphic upright short-legged mascot and original arm-like forelimbs; do not revert to a natural quadruped. All subjects use the SAME head/body size and body reference; only the specified gesture changes. Do not fit or enlarge bent poses. 1 AHA: Gentle happy discovery, alert friendly face and small existing appendage lift, no effect or external object. 2 CHEER: Small pleased celebration lifting the two existing forelimbs/wings/fins comfortably, same supported body and scale. Do not jump or enlarge. 3 SPECIES_A: Gently sway the tip of the single existing tail a little away from the torso on its reference-visible side. 4 SPECIES_B: The same tail starts settling toward its neutral curve; keep face, arms and both planted feet steady. Species constraints: 尾の根元は胴へ一か所だけ接続。尾長・太さ・先端色を変えず、胴を横へ移したり尾を二重に描いたりしない。 Finish with clear clean face/contours and connected complete appendages, without smudges, patchy pigment blobs, doubled parts, jagged alpha halos or clipping. Open eyes preserve reference design with no new glints. Every single part stays visible within its own transparent area. This replaces only the listed failing pose(s); preserve the reference identity and do not create other states. CRITICAL: Every pixel outside the subject silhouette must be genuinely fully transparent. No pale cloud, glow, paper backdrop, smoky halo, ambient colour, matte rectangle, cast shadow, floor or loose pigment outside its contour. Keep texture inside the subject only. Clear viewer-left and viewer-right gesture directions. Retain its rounded animal paws without a human thumb, index finger, fist or extra digit.
